trade_signal_doctrine.entry_logic: Preemptive entry at predicted wick-rejection zone (defensive staff) with tight SL; no waiting for confirmation.
confluences: Confluence 1: ICT/SMC, MSNR, and CRT with Momentum Indicators (RSI). The sweep of sell-side liquidity below the H1 low of 76889.22 down to 76703.59 (ICT/SMC) mitigates the Malaysian SNR (MSNR) support level at 76700. This manipulation phase of the Candle Range Theory (CRT) H4 cycle aligns with the M15 RSI reaching an oversold state of 30.3, signaling momentum exhaustion and a high probability of a preemptive wick-rejection.

Confluence 2: Supply and Demand Zones, Trendline Bounces, and Candlestick Patterns with Volatility Indicators (ATR). The price has retraced into a major H4 demand zone (76500-76800) which intersects with a bullish trendline drawn from the Sept 11 low of 76046.58. The formation of a strong H1 hammer/pin bar candlestick pattern at 08:00 confirms the defensive staff's structural integrity, while the high M15 ATR of 164.05 indicates that the volatility expansion is reaching its outer limits, setting up a sharp mean-reversion bounce.

Confluence 3: Quarter Theory (QT), Break of Structure (BOS), and Fair Value Gap (FVG) with Trend Indicators (H4 EMA50/200). The price has swept through the 77500 major quarter level down to the 76750 minor quarter level (QT), mitigating an unmitigated H4 FVG from Sept 14. While the lower timeframes (M5) show an early bullish BOS above 76885, this entire defensive staff zone aligns with the H4 bullish trend where the EMA50/200 acts as dynamic support, validating a preemptive long entry.

Confluence 4: Fibonacci Retracement, Chart Patterns, and ICT/SMC with Volume Indicators (OBV/Accumulation). The low of 76703.59 represents a precise tap of the 0.786 Fibonacci retracement level (measured from the 76046.58 low to the 79600.00 high). This level forms a potential double bottom chart pattern on the M15 timeframe, where the sweep of the minor lows (ICT/SMC) is accompanied by rising volume/accumulation on the lower wicks, indicating institutional absorption of sell orders.

Confluence 5: Standard Deviation (SD), Candle Range Theory (CRT), and MSNR with Volatility Indicators (Bollinger Bands). The price deviation to -2SD from the H1 mean aligns with the lower boundary of the Bollinger Bands, indicating an extreme extension. This extreme deviation occurs at the MSNR support level of 76700, where the CRT H4 candle shows a long lower shadow (wick rejection), confirming that the defensive staff has successfully held and is ready for a preemptive reversal.

confidence_model.dominant_bias_reason: The H4 trend remains strongly bullish, and the recent deep correction has swept key liquidity pools down to the 0.786 Fibonacci retracement level at 76703.59. This correction has mitigated a major H4 demand zone and met extreme oversold conditions on the M15 RSI (30.3). The strong wick rejection on the H1 and M15 timeframes confirms institutional defense of the 76700-76800 level, making a preemptive buy-limit order highly favorable compared to selling into major HTF support.

risk_profile.note: Preemptive entry captures full HTF continuation without waiting for wick confirmation.
